verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a SaaS compliance platform, so a webhooks story applies to it. The evidence shows only a REST API, email alerts, Slack and Jira task notifications, and status-page email and Slack updates. Under the rubric, chat-app and email notifications do not count as webhooks, and nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for a programmatic consumer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
